units.source_text: 这时候头中将来了，看见源氏公子还睡着，笑道：“好贪睡啊！

en.t: Just then, the Captain came in, saw that Prince Genji was still asleep, and laughed, "How you love to sleep!
Still not up at this hour?

units.source_text: 昨夜一定又有什么勾当了。”

en.t: There must have been some mischief again last night."

units.source_text: 源氏公子只得起身，一面答道：“哪里的话！

en.t: Prince Genji had no choice but to get up, answering as he did so, "Nonsense!

units.source_text: 独个儿睡觉很舒畅，醒得迟了些。

en.t: Sleeping alone was so comfortable that I woke a little late.
Have you just come from the palace?"

units.source_text: 头中将说：“正是，我刚从宫中出来。

en.t: The Captain said, "Exactly. I have just come from the palace.

units.source_text: 万岁爷即将行幸朱雀院，听说今日要选定乐人和舞人呢。

en.t: His Majesty is soon to visit the Suzaku Palace, and I hear that the musicians and dancers are to be chosen today.

units.source_text: 我想去通知父亲一声，所以从宫中退出，乘便也来通知你一声。

en.t: I wanted to let my father know, so I left the palace, and came by to tell you as well.
I am going back to the palace at once."

units.source_text: 看他的样子很匆忙，源氏公子便说：“那么，我跟你同去吧。”

en.t: Seeing how hurried he looked, Prince Genji said, "Then I shall go with you."

units.source_text: 便命拿早粥和糯米饭来，和客人同吃。

en.t: He then ordered morning rice gruel and steamed glutinous rice to be brought, and ate with his guest.

units.source_text: 门前停着二辆车子；但他们两人共乘了一辆。

en.t: Two carriages were waiting at the gate, but the two of them rode together in one.

units.source_text: 一路上头中将总是疑心他，看看他的脸说：“瞧你的样子，还是睡眼蒙眬呢。”

en.t: All along the way, the Captain kept suspecting him, and, looking at his face, said, "Look at you. Your eyes are still heavy with sleep."

units.source_text: 接着又恨恨地说：“你瞒着我做的事情多着哩！”

en.t: Then he added resentfully, "There are plenty of things you do while keeping me in the dark!"
